dismissals: Voice choices and speed are per-document mutations; inspected options without selecting to preserve the draft’s existing voice and speed.

Remaining editor entries are script/timeline content, destructive Delete controls, draft-creation or AI-send controls that would mutate state, or editor tools already tested as inert in this build; they are not safe or useful to operate further.
These controls create persistent collections or drafts; skipped to preserve workspace state.

Remaining controls are repetitive draft cards/ellipsis hotspots (one already proved to open the draft rather than a menu), sidebar draft rows, active Grid/inert toolbar icons, or unsafe workspace/content actions such as invitations; further operation would duplicate tested behavior or risk changing workspace/content state.
